title: Server marker env var names in host_policy must stay equal to mlflow.server.constants
answers: server-side artifact host policy silently stops applying after a rename
which env var marks a process as the tracking server for artifact checks
jobs and runs:/ artifact URIs bypass host check after changing server constants
body:
Invariant: mlflow/store/artifact/host_policy.py mirrors two env var names as _SERVER_ARTIFACT_ROOT_ENV_VAR = "_MLFLOW_SERVER_ARTIFACT_ROOT" and _SERVER_ARTIFACTS_DESTINATION_ENV_VAR = "_MLFLOW_SERVER_ARTIFACT_DESTINATION". They duplicate ARTIFACT_ROOT_ENV_VAR and ARTIFACTS_DESTINATION_ENV_VAR in mlflow/server/constants.py.
The duplication exists because the store layer cannot import mlflow.server (its package __init__ pulls in Flask).
If either name changes on only one side, host_policy.py:is_tracking_server_process returns False without any error, and registry-level enforcement stops for job subprocesses, runs:/ and models:/ URIs.
The test tests/store/artifact/test_host_policy.py:test_marker_env_vars_match_server_constants pins equality. Change both sides and the test together.
applies: Any rename or edit of the server artifact-root or artifacts-destination env vars in mlflow/server/constants.py or the store layer.
says: Server host verification policies are being bypassed when accessing run or model artifacts.
Security checks on artifact storage locations are silently failing during background job execution.
Enforce server artifact host restrictions for all model registry and run artifact downloads.
Unauthorized storage destinations are not blocked when accessing run artifact links.
Background worker tasks bypass artifact security rules without raising any permission errors.
